# ସିଂହାସନ — Singhasan

> ସିଂହାସନ (Singhasan), an Odia poetry collection by ପ୍ରଭାକର ଶତପଥୀ (Pravakar Satapathy).

The original book has opening prose and 68 numbered poems. The listening edition has 71 recordings: 69 in Odia (the preface and poems) and 2 English bookends (welcome and closing).
The canonical section pages below contain the original Odia text in their initial HTML. The listening page contains direct MP3 links and structured recording metadata. English navigation labels are not poem translations.

## Book and poet

- [ସିଂହାସନ — Singhasan](https://singhasan.kabitawithoutborders.org/): Book home.
- [ସିଂହଦ୍ୱାର — Preface](https://singhasan.kabitawithoutborders.org/intro.html): Opening prose.
- [Poems](https://singhasan.kabitawithoutborders.org/contents.html): The complete numbered collection.
- [ପ୍ରଭାକର ଶତପଥୀ — Pravakar Satapathy](https://singhasan.kabitawithoutborders.org/author.html): The poet.
- [Portraits](https://singhasan.kabitawithoutborders.org/portraits.html): Photographic portraits of the poet.
- [Poetry archive](https://singhasan.kabitawithoutborders.org/poetry-archive.html): Other original Odia poems and publication sources, separate from the numbered Singhasan collection.
- [Listen](https://singhasan.kabitawithoutborders.org/listen.html): All 71 recordings, including the Odia preface and 68 poems, with English welcome and closing.
- [Listen and follow](https://singhasan.kabitawithoutborders.org/read-along.html): The enhanced listening reader.
